result:
Everything is verified end to end. `ns build ios` succeeds, and on the Simulator: Home shows title/subtitle/both buttons, Health and Transcribe screens each match their spec text exactly (status line, enabled "Request Access", disabled second button, empty-state text), native back button returns to Home from both, and the app never crashed through the whole flow.

Section 3 (App shell) is implemented:
- `app/components/Home.vue` — title/subtitle + Health/Transcribe buttons, navigates via `$navigateTo`
- `app/components/Health.vue` and `app/components/Transcribe.vue` — static placeholders matching §3.2/§3.3 exactly, with native iOS back navigation to Home

No other spec sections were touched, and `SPEC.md`/`spec-assets/` were left untouched.
